studio.title: Who delivers the work?
studio.description: e.g. 'Fernwood Studio, a six-person design agency', 'a solo brand consultant'.

tools.name: delivery_status
tools.description: The delivery picture in one read, with ids: every approval waiting on a client and for how long, everything due in the next 14 days with late items first, and each active project's health and next milestone. Call it first when asked what's waiting, late or due.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: This week's status for one client project, or every active one: what was approved, what waits on the client, what is in progress, and what comes next. Call it before drafting a status update and write only from it.

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Save a client project: title, client, the client's approver, the studio lead, and the due date (YYYY-MM-DD). An existing title is updated, never duplicated. When the whole project slips, pass shiftDays (days later; negative for earlier) and the board moves its date and every milestone not yet approved. Call it as soon as a project is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: add_milestone
tools.description: Save a milestone on a project: title, due date (YYYY-MM-DD) and owner. An existing title on that project is updated, never duplicated. When a date slips, pass shiftDays (how many days later; negative for earlier) and the board moves it; never work out the new date yourself. Call it as soon as a milestone or a slip is mentioned.

tools.name: set_milestone_status
tools.description: Move a milestone: in-progress when work starts; waiting when it goes to the client for approval (the board starts counting the wait and the round); approved when the client signs off; back to in-progress, with their feedback as note, when they ask for changes. Call it the moment the person says it.

tools.name: list_client_projects
tools.description: Every client project with all of its milestones, statuses and dates.

tools.name: page_add_project
tools.description: Add or update a client project.
